about: Who wrote each translation — the messages in lib/l10n, and the iOS permission prompts in ios/Runner/<lang>.lproj/InfoPlist.strings — and whether a native reader has read it. writtenBy is "assistant" or "person"; nativeRead turns true once a native reader has read the message as it stands, and goes back to false if the message changes. Arabic gates launch: every Arabic message is read before release. The other six do not gate it. English is the source text, not a translation, and is not listed.
